title: Set Matrix Zeroes
keyIdea: If a cell is 0, zero its whole row and column, in place. Use row 0 and column 0 as the "zero this row/column" markers, after saving in two booleans whether they had zeros of their own. Mark, fill the inside, then the header row and column last.

approaches.name: First row and column as markers
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). Save firstRowZero / firstColZero; for inside zeros set matrix[i][0] = matrix[0][j] = 0; zero inside cells whose header is 0; then the headers.
approaches.why: A few passes over the grid; only two extra booleans.

quiz.q: Why not zero rows and columns as soon as you see a 0?
options: The new zeros would then trigger more rows and columns that shouldn't be zeroed

quiz.q: Why are row 0 and column 0 handled last?
options: They hold the marks; zeroing them early would wipe or fake marks
